_about: Captures for tools/clinical_trial_check.py (issue #162). Each response was captured live by H5 from this build environment with the tool's own urllib fetch, keyless, on 2026-10-24. Each fixture is the response as a transcript: the status line, the headers one per line in the order returned with any Set-Cookie header omitted (the safety_file fixture precedent: a session cookie is not evidence and is never committed), a blank line, then the body exactly as returned. The sha256 under each file name is the hash of the fixture file, checked by tools/pregate.py; body_sha256 and body_bytes are the values for the body alone, which matches the returned body byte for byte.
